client.name: Daniel Lim
client.background: A private-banking client who manages a family investment portfolio alongside a trading business. He reviews his holdings personally but sometimes refers to an older portfolio note when giving instructions.
client.investment_objective: Reduce emerging-market credit exposure and make more of the portfolio available for anticipated family spending.
client.loss_attitude: Accepts that selling an investment can crystallise a loss and is willing to do so to reduce unwanted exposure, while preferring control over the minimum execution price.

setting.call_reason: The client calls to arrange a disposal from his existing holdings. He initially draws on an older portfolio note, then replaces that instruction after checking his current review notes.
setting.conversation_style: The client is courteous, concise and comfortable in both English and Mandarin. English leads the conversation, with natural switches into Mandarin for personal details and portfolio context. The employee remains professional and keeps the discussion focused.

final_product.description: Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund is a bond fund providing exposure to emerging-market issuers, with performance dependent on credit conditions, interest rates and market liquidity.
concrete_risks: Deteriorating issuer credit quality or defaults can reduce the value of the fund's underlying bonds.
Emerging-market political or economic disruption can cause sharp valuation changes and make underlying bonds harder to sell.
Rising interest rates can reduce bond valuations and therefore the fund's value.
A sell limit order may remain unexecuted if the available dealing price does not meet the specified limit.
final_product.recommendation_basis: Reducing the Crest holding lowers exposure to emerging-market credit and liquidity pressures, supporting the client's wish to simplify his risk exposure and prepare for family spending. A limit instruction accommodates his preference for a minimum acceptable disposal price, although execution is not assured.

other_products.description: Orion Global Income Fund is a bond fund held in the client's portfolio and named in the earlier disposal instruction that is withdrawn before execution.

parsed_response.holding_context: The client holds both Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund and Orion Global Income Fund. Either holding could plausibly have been selected for a disposal, but the current portfolio review identifies Crest as the holding he wants to reduce.

edge_case_context.motivation: During the identity check, the client makes a verbal memory slip while giving a personal detail in English and immediately corrects himself in Mandarin within the same turn.

The client initially follows an older portfolio note in Mandarin. After consulting his current review notes, he switches to English and replaces the earlier disposal instruction in full before execution. The replacement reflects a change in which holding he wants to reduce and his preference for price control.

The client uses Mandarin to discuss the portfolio balance and a hypothetical smaller disposal as context, then returns to English for the actual commitment. The contextual figures serve different purposes and are not additional orders.

additional_discussion_topics: The client's preference for keeping portfolio review notes organised
